Known findings remain resolved and no current product release blocker is identified in this bounded review. Local supplied acceptance is complete; commit/CI results are not inferred. conclusion.scoring_reason: The current evidence permits auditable categorical PASS/partial-coverage judgments for observed behavior. It does not establish calibrated 0-100 results across all ten dimensions: task-efficiency, full accessibility, performance distributions and native fault outcomes remain only partially observed. The review declines retrospective arbitrary weights. NOT_SCORED means no defensible numerical mark is issued, not a failed native acceptance or CI-only evidence.
conclusion.approval_limit: Ready for the scoped commit/CI step based on supplied local evidence; this reviewer did not commit, run CI, operate a browser or run extra tests. This is not a global proof of unrelated framework release contracts.
